w:r.w:t: For the ledger team's on-duty engineer. Invented for the Forge fixtures.
Transfers received after 16:30 are settled on the next business day.
Saturday and Sunday are not business days; neither are the bank holidays in the operations calendar.

When a customer reports being charged twice, compare the idempotency keys of the two payments before refunding: the same key means Northwind Pay received one payment and the second line is a display fault in the portal.
Only the fraud desk may freeze an account. A frozen account still receives incoming transfers but refuses every outgoing one until the desk lifts the freeze.
